prediction_text: Direction: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election — this is the call of the Costa Mesa ISAR election forecasting panel as a body. The panel's collective judgment favours Clinton over Trump in the election of 8 November 2016 (timing coordinate: the election date on the card). The panel call is stated plainly as the panel majority's single direction; individual dissenting panelists, if any, are not the subject of this card.
basis: This card bears no tradition/system field; it asks for the reported collective judgment of an astrology conference election panel, and is answered on that face. Card facts: Democrat Clinton faces Republican Trump, most polls favour Clinton, an international astrology conference in Costa Mesa is holding an election forecasting panel in October 2016. The item being predicted is the panel's consensus call, and the conference-panel consensus in that setting — aligned with the polling state given on the card — is a Clinton call; the prediction therefore records the panel's direction (Clinton) as the master judgment for this case, irrespective of any individual forecaster. No charts are supplied and none are fabricated. Note on scope: this case and WP-005 are separate cards on the same election with different subjects (panel body vs. one identified panelist); each is answered for its own subject only.
